t: Li Yuanhao levied every man between 15 and 60, put as many as 370,000 under arms, promulgated the Tangut script in 1036 and in 1038 declared himself emperor of the Great Xia; after six years of war the Song recognised him and paid an annual tribute of 250,000 units of silk, silver and tea.

For most of the 11th century child emperors reigned under empress dowagers and their clans, the Mocang and then two generations of the Liang; Empress Dowager Liang rode at the head of the cavalry against the Song until she was poisoned by Liao assassins in 1099.

Western Xia pioneered printing with ceramic and wooden movable type, and under Emperor Renzong (1139–1193) founded schools, examinations and a Hanlin Academy and completed most of the Tangut Buddhist canon; the Mongols destroyed the state so thoroughly that its history stayed obscure until the 20th century.
dyk: The Auspicious Tantra of All-Reaching Union, a 449-page Tangut text found in the ruins of the Baisigou Square Pagoda in the Helan Mountains, is the earliest surviving book printed with wooden movable type; twelve Tangut titles printed with movable type survive today.
ev: Li Yuanhao declares himself emperor of the Great Xia at Xingqing, taking the Tangut clan name Weiming and creating a Chinese-style bureaucracy.
After victories at Sanchuan Pass and Haoshuichuan and the repulse of a Liao invasion of 100,000, Jingzong makes peace: the Song recognise him and pay 250,000 units of silk, silver and tea a year.
The Song launch a five-pronged invasion while the Liang clan imprisons Emperor Huizong; Lanzhou falls, but the Xia flood the Song camps by breaching the Yellow River dikes.
Empress Dowager Liang, who led armies in person, is poisoned by assassins from the Liao; the Song 'advance and fortify' campaign has built 40 forts across the Ordos.
Emperor Chongzong turns away the fugitive Liao emperor Tianzuo and declares himself a vassal of the Jurchen Jin.
Emperor Renzong institutes imperial examinations, after founding schools throughout the country and Confucian temples.
After the Mongol siege of Zhongxing, Emperor Xiangzong submits to Genghis Khan, giving him his daughter Chaka and a tribute of camels, falcons and textiles.
Emperor Mo surrenders after a six-month siege and is executed; the Mongols slaughter the capital's population and plunder the imperial tombs.

f.founder: Li Yuanhao (Emperor Jingzong), who declared himself emperor in 1038; Li Jiqian built the independent Tangut state from 982
f.predecessor: The Tangut Dingnan Jiedushi (Xiasui) of the Tuoba/Li clan, 881–982; the Ganzhou Uyghur Kingdom and the Guiyi Circuit, annexed by 1036
f.successor: The Mongol Empire, which destroyed the state in 1227
